name: Magical Savant
body:
School divination; Level alchemist 2, bard 2, magus 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You align your magical energies with those of an object. For the duration of the spell you gain a +4 insight bonus on Use Magic Device checks with that object. If you have 10 or more ranks in Use Magic Device, you can take 10 on Use Magic Device checks with the item, even if the situation wouldn t normally allow you to do so.
